title: Toward a Layer-2 Trigger for AI/ML Lifecycle Management in 6G
abstract: arXiv:2609.14517v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3GPP has progressively expanded AI/ML lifecycle management in the radio access network, from one-sided model control to Release 20 support for two-sided CSI-feedback model pairing. Yet a basic control question remains: when monitoring detects degradation, how quickly must a corrective action take effect? To expose this dependency, we stress-test three activation and rollback strategies in a surrogate regime-shift environment using 150 independently trained PPO candidate policies, each evaluated over 20 matched noise realizations. We add 0-40 control-step delay only to corrective lifecycle commands. With no added delay, stability-gated blending reduces mean post-shift cumulative SLA deficit from 47.02 to 7.57 violation-steps relative to hard cutover; at 40 steps, the deficit rises to 44.38, only 5.6% below the hard-cutover baseline. translated_title: 面向6G中AI/ML生命周期管理的层2触发器
translated_abstract: 3GPP已逐步扩展了无线接入网络中的AI/ML生命周期管理，从单侧模型控制发展到Release 20对双侧CSI反馈模型配对的支持。然而一个基本的控制问题仍然存在：当监控检测到性能退化时，纠正性措施必须多快生效？为了揭示这一依赖关系，我们在一个代理式状态突变环境中对三种激活和回滚策略进行了压力测试，使用了150个独立训练的PPO候选策略，每个策略在20个匹配的噪声实现上进行评估。我们仅在纠正性生命周期命令上添加0-40个控制步骤的延迟。在没有额外延迟的情况下，与硬切换相比，稳定性门控融合策略将状态突变后的平均累积SLA违规从47.02个违规步骤降低至7.57个；而当延迟达到40步时，该违规上升至44.38，仅比硬切换基线低5.6%。KPI阈值回滚在短短几个控制间隔内便失去了其优势，而融合策略的性能也随之退化（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究通过大规模压力测试揭示了6G中AI/ML生命周期管理对纠正措施延迟的高度敏感性——稳定性门控融合策略在零延迟时能将SLA违规降低约84%，但40步延迟几乎使其优势消失，从而论证了在层2引入快速触发机制的必要性。
en_tdlr: Through large-scale stress testing, this work reveals the acute delay sensitivity of AI/ML lifecycle management in 6G—stability-gated blending reduces SLA violations by about 84% at zero delay, but its advantage nearly vanishes at 40-step delay, motivating a fast Layer-2 trigger for corrective actions.
